content.short: Eisen Finance is a multichain DEX aggregator connecting 20+ EVM chains with optimized swap execution and unique CEX liquidity integration.
content.description: Eisen Finance is a sophisticated DEX aggregator connecting liquidity across more than 20 EVM-compatible blockchains, with a unique feature that integrates CEX liquidity for advanced use cases including delta-neutral yield farming and hedge trading. This hybrid on-chain and off-chain liquidity model allows traders to access best execution across the widest possible range of price sources. Eisen Finance is deployed on Mantle and supports cross-chain routes for both simple swaps and complex trading strategies.
